title: Adversative Contrast Markers: Azonban, Viszont & Mindazonáltal

sections.title: Contrast Markers
sections.content: To introduce sharp or nuanced contrast between ideas, Hungarian uses adversative conjunctions: *azonban* (however - positioned second in the clause), *viszont* (on the other hand, but), and *mindazonáltal* (nevertheless, nonetheless).

items.spanish: Az elmélet vonzó, a gyakorlatban azonban komoly nehézségek adódnak.
items.english: The theory is attractive; in practice, however, serious difficulties arise.

items.spanish: Sokan elutasították a javaslatot, ő viszont határozottan kiállt mellette.
items.english: Many rejected the proposal; he, on the other hand, stood firmly by it.

items.spanish: A helyzet bonyolult, mindazonáltal van remény a békés megállapodásra.
items.english: The situation is complex; nonetheless, there is hope for a peaceful agreement.
